classification_engines_enabled.title: Active Classification Engines
classification_engines_enabled.description: List of content inspection engines currently enabled (e.g., pattern_matching, fingerprinting, ml_classifier, exact_data_match)

false_positive_rate_percent.title: False Positive Rate (%)
false_positive_rate_percent.description: Measured percentage of DLP alerts that are false positives over the last 30 days, indicating tuning quality

custom_pattern_definitions_count.title: Custom Pattern Definitions Count
custom_pattern_definitions_count.description: Number of organization-specific custom regex or keyword patterns defined in the DLP policy beyond built-in templates

last_classifier_tuning_days.title: Days Since Last Classifier Tuning
last_classifier_tuning_days.description: Number of days elapsed since DLP classifiers or pattern sets were last reviewed and tuned

monitored_channels.title: DLP Monitored Network Channels
monitored_channels.description: List of network channels actively monitored and blocked by the DLP system (e.g., HTTP, HTTPS, SMTP, FTP, cloud_upload)

blocking_mode_enabled.title: DLP Inline Blocking Mode Enabled
blocking_mode_enabled.description: Indicates whether the DLP system is operating in active inline blocking mode (not just monitor/alert mode) for network channels

ssl_tls_inspection_active.title: SSL/TLS Inspection Active (Network DLP)
ssl_tls_inspection_active.description: Indicates whether SSL/TLS decryption and inspection is active on the network DLP appliance or proxy for encrypted channels. Merged from ssl_tls_inspection_active and ssl_tls_interception_enabled; use this single attribute for both network_channel_prevention_coverage and encrypted_traffic_inspection_capability rules.

endpoint_dlp_agent_deployed.title: Endpoint DLP Agent Deployed
endpoint_dlp_agent_deployed.description: Whether a DLP agent is installed and active on endpoints to enforce data movement controls

enforced_control_channels.title: Enforced Data Movement Control Channels
enforced_control_channels.description: List of endpoint data movement channels actively blocked or monitored by DLP policy (e.g., usb_storage, clipboard, print_to_file, screen_capture, local_sync)

policy_enforcement_mode.title: DLP Policy Enforcement Mode
policy_enforcement_mode.description: The operational mode of the endpoint DLP policy determining whether violations are actively blocked or only logged

sensitive_data_patterns_configured.title: Sensitive Data Patterns Configured
sensitive_data_patterns_configured.description: Whether content inspection rules with sensitive data patterns (e.g., PII, PCI, PHI, IP) are configured and enabled in the DLP policy

casb_integration_enabled.title: CASB Integration Enabled
casb_integration_enabled.description: Whether a Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB) is integrated with the DLP system to enforce policies on cloud services

cloud_upload_blocking_policy_status.title: Cloud Upload Blocking Policy Status
cloud_upload_blocking_policy_status.description: Operational status of DLP policies that block sensitive data uploads to cloud storage and collaboration platforms

monitored_cloud_services.title: Monitored Cloud Services
monitored_cloud_services.description: List of cloud storage and collaboration platforms covered by DLP/CASB policies (e.g., SharePoint, Google Drive, Dropbox, Box, Slack)

automated_response_actions_enabled.title: Automated Response Actions Enabled
automated_response_actions_enabled.description: Indicates whether the DLP system is configured to automatically execute response actions (quarantine, block, alert, SIEM forwarding) upon policy violation detection without requiring manual intervention.

configured_response_actions.title: Configured Response Actions
configured_response_actions.description: List of automated response actions configured in the DLP system. Expected values include 'block', 'quarantine', 'alert', 'user_notification', 'siem_forwarding'.

siem_forwarding_configured.title: SIEM Forwarding Configured
siem_forwarding_configured.description: Indicates whether DLP policy violations are automatically forwarded to a SIEM system for centralized logging, correlation, and audit trail maintenance.

policies_in_enforcement_mode.title: Policies in Enforcement Mode
policies_in_enforcement_mode.description: Number of DLP policies that are actively set to enforcement (blocking/quarantine) mode rather than monitor-only or simulation mode.

audit_logging_enabled.title: Audit Logging Enabled
audit_logging_enabled.description: Whether the DLP system has audit/event logging actively enabled and configured to write logs to a destination

logged_fields.title: Logged Event Fields
logged_fields.description: List of fields captured per DLP event log entry (e.g., sender, recipient, data_classification, action_taken, timestamp, content_snippet)

tamper_protection_mechanism.title: Log Tamper Protection Mechanism
tamper_protection_mechanism.description: The mechanism used to ensure audit logs are tamper-evident or tamper-proof

rule_versioning_enabled.title: Rule Versioning Enabled
rule_versioning_enabled.description: Whether the DLP policy management system tracks version history for policy rules, enabling rollback and audit of changes.

policy_approval_workflow_status.title: Policy Approval Workflow Status
policy_approval_workflow_status.description: Indicates whether a formal workflow-based approval process exists for policy changes before they are promoted to production.

staged_rollout_mode.title: Staged Rollout Mode
staged_rollout_mode.description: Whether new or modified DLP policies are deployed first in monitor-only mode before transitioning to enforce mode, reducing operational disruption.

false_positive_feedback_loop_configured.title: False Positive Feedback Loop Configured
false_positive_feedback_loop_configured.description: Whether the DLP system has a formal mechanism for users or analysts to report false positives and for those reports to feed back into policy tuning.

classification_framework_integration_sta.title: Classification Framework Integration Status
classification_framework_integration_sta.description: Whether the DLP system is actively integrated with the enterprise data classification framework (e.g., Microsoft Purview, Titus, Boldon James) to consume sensitivity labels

identity_context_enforcement_enabled.title: Identity-Aware Context Enforcement Enabled
identity_context_enforcement_enabled.description: Whether DLP policies incorporate identity context (user role, group membership, or device posture) to apply graduated enforcement rather than uniform block/allow decisions

graduated_policy_action_count.title: Number of Distinct Graduated Policy Actions Configured
graduated_policy_action_count.description: Count of distinct enforcement actions (e.g., allow, log-only, user-notify, manager-notify, block-with-override, hard-block) configured across active DLP policies, indicating policy graduation depth

inspection_scope.title: SSL/TLS Inspection Traffic Scope
inspection_scope.description: Defines what portion of encrypted traffic is subject to DLP inspection — none, partial (e.g., only certain categories or ports), or full (all SSL/TLS traffic).

certificate_trust_chain_valid.title: Interception Certificate Trust Chain Valid
certificate_trust_chain_valid.description: Indicates whether the SSL interception CA certificate is properly deployed to endpoints so that decrypted-and-re-encrypted traffic is trusted without bypass attempts by end-user agents.

dlp_policy_applied_to_decrypted_traffic.title: DLP Policy Applied to Decrypted Traffic
dlp_policy_applied_to_decrypted_traffic.description: Confirms that DLP inspection rules and sensitive data patterns are actively enforced against decrypted SSL/TLS payloads, not just metadata or plaintext channels.
